title: Multi-climate data curriculum and leave-event-out validation

primary_new_source.product: CDC 10-minute station observations of air temperature

variables.TT_10: air temperature at 2 m, degree Celsius
variables.PP_10: air pressure at station level, hPa
variables.TD_10: dew point temperature, degree Celsius; retained for source audit only

pressure_contract.model_field_definition: auditable standard-atmosphere sea-level reduction using station elevation and current temperature

secondary_sources.role: existing India-domain reference and global external-domain expansion

secondary_sources.provider: Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry, Jena
secondary_sources.role: future independent single-site temporal reconstruction check; not a neighbour-network benchmark
India live demonstration after IP whitelisting
neighbour/reanalysis context and genuine regional-event corroboration, not a fault label

integrity_rules: Every downloaded file must have URL, byte count and SHA-256 in a manifest.
No 2025 DWD or NOAA label is opened during Iteration 8 development.
DWD 2024 remains locked until the model and thresholds are frozen.
Dew point and any non-SIH meteorological variable are never detector features.
Source quality codes are used only for clean-row eligibility and audit.
All validation splits are separated by complete event, station group and time.
